title: Crimped Paint Tube Kit
description: One original static paint-tube kit counted as one prop: three differently compressed soft-metal tubes with integral sloping shoulders, modeled hollow necks, finite folded crimp tails and ribbed screw-cap forms. Two caps are fitted over the necks; the third tube is open with a real visible bore and blind internal cavity, and its separate cap rests upright on a finite annular rim beside the set. Muted blue, ochre and vermilion bands are assigned to the body faces, not duplicate overlay surfaces, brands or text labels. Each tube has a finite flat lower body facet and its crimp joins the solid tail region; all components are supported in one arranged rest pose. Nine named editable closed meshes, six constant solid PBR materials, metres, native Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. No paint-flow, squeezing, cap animation, chemical composition, usable quantity, sealing, toxicity, painting performance or manufacturing guarantee.
